title: SeamlessM4T: Massively Multilingual & Multimodal Machine Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating translation overgeneralization to masculine forms from gender-neutral English inputs, comparing translation quality (using chrF, ASR-chrF, and BLASER 2.0 metrics) between masculine and feminine source sentences, and analyzing representation bias by measuring the frequency of masculine vs. feminine nouns and pronouns in the training datasets.
